title: Don’t miss Moserrat
text: Montserrat was not to be missed visit. The mountains were incredible. The church and the black Madonna inspiring. The steps in the church and the line was a little long, but it was worth it.
author: H3462DZstephaniej

title: Lovely views
text: Overall, this was a good experience and an interesting trip. It includes a one hour bus ride to get to the monastery and another to return. Fortunately, the bus was air-conditioned. The guides spoke for a few minutes at the beginning and end of each press ride to Telus history, and explain what we would be seeing. Most of our time there was spent independently to see what we chose in any order. Many chose to walk “the way of the cross“. The views up there were breathtaking.
author: Barbara_H
